body:
Publishes the Task C0 audit that was previously retained only in the shared workspace. The owner explicitly requested that the audit results also be submitted. This is an **evidence-only Draft PR**, stacked on existing #133; no duplicate runtime implementation or new product-test execution is claimed.

Read the [audit report](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/8ede5f8f3f525baf90ad8c9b4f3f0729c19a7b82/docs/implementation/evidence/c0-hosted-runtime-audit-20261022/README.md), [machine audit](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/8ede5f8f3f525baf90ad8c9b4f3f0729c19a7b82/docs/implementation/evidence/c0-hosted-runtime-audit-20261022/audit.json), [open finding](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/8ede5f8f3f525baf90ad8c9b4f3f0729c19a7b82/docs/implementation/evidence/c0-hosted-runtime-audit-20261022/findings.json), [all-79 comparison](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/8ede5f8f3f525baf90ad8c9b4f3f0729c19a7b82/docs/implementation/evidence/c0-hosted-runtime-audit-20261022/failure-comparison.json), and [non-Author handoff](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/8ede5f8f3f525baf90ad8c9b4f3f0729c19a7b82/docs/implementation/evidence/c0-hosted-runtime-audit-20261022/handoff.txt).

### Result and finding

- Existing #133 resolves the hosted SQLite incompatibility through an upstream complete CPython distribution. Published upstream digest matches the manifest; actual Python 3.12.15 loads built-in SQLite 3.53.1 and passes unchanged product guards. No SQLite component download/build/substitution or loader override.
- Audit reverified 150 published payload members, all three inner receipt indexes, byte-identical freshly retrieved live log receipts, 456 source-input hashes and eight matching hosted runtime measurements.
- Bounded I4 217/217 and I5 29/29 pass; both installed wheel forms execute their checks. Original Access smokes retain exit 1 at the Transfer fence.
- Broad regression retains 3,058 pass / 59 failures / 20 setup errors, zero skips; all 79 non-success nodes/phases/refusals/full source frames remain, zero added/resolved. Four raw messages differ in per-run temporary paths and remain explicitly disclosed.
- **C0-E1 Low remains OPEN:** the emitter permits 4 MiB while ADR 0001 VAL-07 specifies 2 MiB. Synthetic counterexample emits 2,323,560 compressed bytes. Actual Access receipt is 1,632,586 bytes and remains within policy. Recommended cap correction/boundary tests are recorded; this PR does not implement them.

### Exact freeze

- Audited baseline #132: `a022dd3efb9c8116cf9dc0abc13ab1d5bbc88e37`, tree `1fa9c2624a3913d97439f16fcd6bc8641c56b17f`.
- **Sole publication parent / base #133:** `f16e5b1713bde9a2f18263a25397c4b450fd5773`, tree `6bfa580baafa9f6a117b7a0b610c4e65cd031b86`; branch `fix/adr0032-host-runtime-20261022`.
- **Publication HEAD:** `8ede5f8f3f525baf90ad8c9b4f3f0729c19a7b82`.
- **Publication tree:** `65e9311819ec354cbc3d6ede1cbc10ebd5c2ced9`.
- One commit, seven added files under `docs/implementation/evidence/c0-hosted-runtime-audit-20261022/`: README, artifact index, original audit ZIP, audit JSON, lossless JSON rendering of original TSV rows, findings JSON and original handoff.
- Original audit ZIP: **11,725,377 bytes**, SHA-256 `dac876bf5c56902971f6424d1c910dac26ebe29403a80dac4cd15bf6b9fbca12`; preserved byte-for-byte, 32 indexed payload members plus index.
- Earlier evidence publication `14b7901` is the audited evidence pin. Live refresh also found adjacent final audit `4cd083b0f7295a2bbaa2597ef483af46e77f5463`; it is linked separately, not rewritten or presented as this submission.

### Publication validation and limits

Local publication checks pass: `git diff --cached --check`, repository report validation (**455 files**), SQLite policy detector (**0 violations**), UTF-8/JSON/fences, seven local links, six publication payload hashes, original ZIP's 32 member hashes, exact lossless equality of all 79 converted rows, original audit/handoff/archive byte preservation and additions-only scope.

The original TSV's CRLF/multiline whitespace caused the initial publication whitespace check to refuse it. The expanded copy is now lossless JSON; the original TSV remains unchanged inside the frozen ZIP. The exact cap-predicate anchor is line 64; original audit references adjacent body extraction at line 63, explicitly explained.

No product pytest, distribution rebuild, new hosted product execution or new independent-review PASS is claimed for this publication. Historical runtime executions and fresh local C0 tooling checks are distinguished in the report. Full repository/sdist inputs change because evidence is added; the publication sdist is not claimed tested merely because runtime blobs are unchanged. [Hosted publication checks 39868206568, attempt 1](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/39868206568) **passed** both `offline` and `sqlite-policy`. Actual test merge `4af86f2511cb313c3a6dbfbd110d7884a195ddba` has parents exact #133 + publication HEAD and the same tree `65e9311819ec354cbc3d6ede1cbc10ebd5c2ced9`. The retrieved log receipt's 21 indexed payload members and feature/merge/tree/run/attempt bindings were verified. Manifest: `development_checks_passed`, `full_acceptance=false`, **0 executed product pytest IDs / 211 acceptance files unexecuted**; documentation publication CI is not product execution.

PRs #132–#135, I6 branch, production source/DDL/UDFs/tests/workflows, accepted ADRs and prior evidence remain unchanged. No merge, deployment, release, P8 or real Provider/catalog operation.
